contexts.text: Evils and falsities are (thus) confirmed and strengthened.
That the Lord thus strengthened the goods and truths. Signified, Explained.
Strengthen thy hand in him () = sustentation thence.
That truth and good may be formed and strengthened with those in temptation.
The inmost things are thus strengthened.
By means of scientifics (such) can strengthen their faith. HH 356.
In proportion as man uses this power, God strengthens it.
Some (observe the Holy Supper) because it strengthens faith.
I have strengthened thee, yea, I have helped thee () = to give power and intelligence from omnipotence and omniscience which are from Divine good through Divine truth.
Mine arm shall strengthen him () = omnipotence therefrom.
They corroborate their doctrinals. Signified, Explained. AE 789.
The establishment and corroboration of that dogma.
Confirmation from the sense of the letter... and thus corroboration (or strengthening) of that dogma.
Confirmations from nature strengthen spiritual truths.
Heresy may be thus strengthened even to the destruction of truth.
